findings.text: follow-on: the measure paragraph reports the focused gate as 36 passed in 30.40s, taken before a187ec0ab added a case, while the head runs 37 passed; the landed record's own count is one behind its head, a reader-facing staleness the node can correct by a later edit.

follow-on: the docstring still cites plan_review.store_delivered_report, the name this change made private, so the reference no longer resolves; it lies outside the reviewed node's write scope and the reviewed manifest records it as a follow-on.

follow-on: read_plan_review is still called without the plan at reckon/cli.py:2613 and reckon/mcp.py:4324, so an answer on a section-covered plan reads as unreviewed there; the plan's recorded cut assigns both callers to the sibling node the-surfaces-pass-the-plan, so this is deferred work rather than a defect of this node.

item_verdicts.diff: read against fa990e12e; three commits: 338194ef1 hoists the store step to plan_review.store_delivered_reviews, makes store_delivered_report private, adds _record_store_error and _review_blob_matches, records store_error on a refused sidecar and names it in the gate refusal, and re-expresses read_plan_review over the coverage predicate with the gate taking its record from it; b51dac1ae lands the evidence fragment; a187ec0ab adds _clear_store_error so a delivery stored on a later pass loses its stale store_error, with a two-pass test.
item_verdicts.done_when: within its half, every done-when condition holds at head: the landing fragment names each named delivery's cause (an identical-content sibling overwrote one identity; one waited on a build gate that never judged it; nine had no store step run at all); a refused delivery carries store_error on its sidecar and the gate refusal names the reason (test_a_refused_store_records_its_reason_on_the_sidecar_and_in_the_refusal); grep 'def _store_delivered_plan_review' reckon/ returns nothing; grep 'def store_delivered_reviews' returns one line in reckon/crew/plan_review.py; grep 'def store_delivered_report' returns nothing and 'def _store_delivered_report' returns one line in reckon/crew/plan_review.py; a plan covered section by section but not as a whole document reads as reviewed through read_plan_review given the plan and through the gate (test_a_plan_covered_section_by_section_reads_as_reviewed_with_its_plan); require_plan_reviewed holds no selection of its own over the covering records; the store step records every refused store rather than skipping it. The plan's recorded cut explicitly defers the answer-verb store and the grep for no read_plan_review call without the plan to the sibling node.
item_verdicts.goal: the node performs the first half of section 23 that the plan's own recorded cut assigns it, and each act is present at the head: the module-private routing._store_delivered_plan_review is gone, the store step is the public plan_review.store_delivered_reviews (plan_review.py:1180) called by the gate, store_delivered_report is private (plan_review.py:1136), a refused store records its reason as store_error on the delivery's own sidecar and the gate names it in the refusal, and read_plan_review given the plan returns the newest covering record with the gate taking its record from that call (routing.py:2676); the section's second half - the answer verb storing before it answers and the CLI and MCP callers passing the plan - is assigned by the same recorded cut to the sibling node the-surfaces-pass-the-plan.
item_verdicts.manifest: reads status complete, commits 338194ef1, b51dac1ae and a187ec0ab, names the gate command and its result, and carries test_logs baseline-suite.log, after-suite.log, gate-head.log and negative-control.log; it records baseline_suite and after_suite arms that each name the revision, tree and command they ran, and I reproduced the head arm independently, so the added-failure count is a measured zero rather than unmeasured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: every changed path lies inside the run's declared write paths - reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_a_delivered_review_that_is_not_stored_says_why.py, tests/test_plan_review_dispatch.py, and docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-is-reviewed-before-it-is-built/a-delivered-review-that-is-not-stored-says-why.html - verified from the diffstat of fa990e12e..a187ec0ab and by grepping the head tree.

justifications.durability: the refusal path is mutation-proven and the read-path re-expression is covered by a test asserting the plan-less read finds nothing while the plan-carrying read and the gate both find the covering record; the finding that a stale store_error survives a later clean store is now closed by _clear_store_error with a two-pass test that refuses, stores, and asserts the key is gone and the delivery reads stored, so the repair the earlier review demanded is landed and evidenced.
justifications.evidence: the head arm passes and I reproduced it independently in a scratch extraction of a187ec0ab (37 passed, EXIT=0, header naming module.__file__ and cwd), the declared negative control reproduces (bare continue on a refused store, 1 failed, EXIT=1, on the store_error case the head arm does not fail), public_definitions is 1482 at base fa990e12e and 1482 at head, and every done-when grep holds at head; deducted one because the landed evidence fragment's own measure paragraph still reports the focused gate as 36 passed while the head after a187ec0ab runs 37, so the landing record carries a count one behind its own head.
justifications.fit: the new definitions are named by the mechanism they perform (store_delivered_reviews, _record_store_error, _clear_store_error, _review_blob_matches) and no plan or ticket identifier appears in code or symbols, the test module named for the behaviour it covers; deducted one because write_review_sidecar's signature widened to all-optional parameters, so a caller can pass neither the named fields nor a payload and no invariant stops it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node does exactly the first-half acts the plan's recorded cut assigns it, each verified at the head (the hoist, the private report store, the store_error recording and refusal detail, the coverage-based read the gate now takes its record from, and the stale-reason clear), and the deferred half is named by the same cut as the sibling node rather than missing.
justifications.reuse: the store step was moved rather than duplicated and its single copy is called by the gate, the sidecar keeps one writer through which both the record and the clear step read back and rewrite the delivery's own bytes, and the coverage read reuses _review_coverage and _review_blob_matches instead of re-deriving the match.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path lies inside the run's declared write paths and the evidence-fragment directory; no shared index, sprint state or other plan was touched; the third commit a187ec0ab stayed inside reckon/crew/plan_review.py and the declared test module.
